; Nimzoid personality for Rodent V
;
; configured by Pawel Koziol
;
; likes closed positions, restricting opponents mobility
; and attacking enemy king. Plays old-fashioned, provocative
; openings and likes to figure them out by himself.
; based on an old net, horizontal mirrorring must be off
;
setoption name nnuePath value nets/rodent_4kb_768hl_8ob_v2.bin
setoption name mainBookPath value books/nimzowitsch.bin
setoption name guideBookPath value books/empty.bin
setoption name hceWeight value 60
setoption name nnueWeight value 30
setoption name horizontalMirroring value 1
setoption name nnueScale value 206
setoption name likesClosed value 100
setoption name kingTropism value 0
setoption name forwardness value 0
setoption name OwnMaterial value 100
setoption name OppMaterial value 100
setoption name OwnPST value 100
setoption name OppPST value 100
setoption name OwnMobility value 100
setoption name OppMobility value 125
setoption name OwnSafety value 90
setoption name OppSafety value 115
setoption name OwnPawns value 100
setoption name OppPawns value 100
setoption name OwnPassers value 100
setoption name OppPassers value 100
setoption name OwnThreats value 75
setoption name OppThreats value 75
setoption name OwnOther value 100
setoption name OppOther value 100
